resources.string: Animated rain radar for your current location, refreshed every 5 minutes.
No location yet – open the app to set up
Complete these steps once. Afterwards the widget refreshes every 5 minutes in the background without further interaction.
Auto follows widget size (the current default). Choose a fixed zoom to override it; 2 shows the widest area.
Used to centre the radar map on where you are.
Lets the widget follow you while the app is closed.
Required for the exact 5-minute refresh. Without it Android may delay refreshes to roughly every 9 minutes or longer.

Allows network access while the phone is idle. In the list, switch to “All apps”, choose Forecast and select “Don’t optimize”. Some manufacturers (Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, …) additionally require allowing autostart / removing the app from “sleeping apps”.
Larger widgets show a wider area (2×2 → zoom 100, 3×3 → 75, 4×4 → 50, …).

Forecast collects your location data to show the rain radar for your current position in the home-screen widget, even when the app is closed or not in use. Your coordinates are only sent to forecast.by.vincent.mahn.ke to render the map and are not shared otherwise.\n\nOn the next screen choose “Allow all the time”.
